diagnosis: The CSV export download route processes marketing lead lists through a streaming pipeline based solely on req.params.exportJobId. It does not verify that the export job was initiated by the authenticated user's organization. An unauthorized actor can download competitor marketing leads, prospect emails, and estimated contract values by enumerating job IDs.
exploit_request:
GET /exports/csv/job_leads_enterprise_4021 HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.pipeline.internal:8090
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: text/csv
